competences: Explain the two levels of government and their different duties.
Identify local council levels and explain decentralisation.
languageCompetence: Read, spell and write the key Social Studies terms used in this lesson.
objectives: Give the meaning of a government.
Name the two levels of government in Uganda and give differences between them.
Name the levels of local government and explain decentralisation.
references: P.5 Social Studies Lesson Notes Term III: Uganda as an Independent Nation
ALL SST Notes P 4 TO P 7 ALL Terms Excel 3

steps.teacherActivity: Explain the meaning and role of government.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners identify government as the ruling body of the country.

source.quote: A government is a ruling body of a country.

steps.teacherActivity: Explain and compare central and local government.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners state differences in roads, hospitals and areas of authority.

source.quote: Difference between the central government and local government.

steps.teacherActivity: Present the local council structure and explain decentralisation.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners identify council levels and describe benefits of decentralisation.

steps.teacherActivity: Ask and review the exercise questions on government and decentralisation.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners answer and correct the sourced questions.

source.quote: It brings services nearer to people

assessment: Assess learners with the source-written questions in the exercise and check their correct answers.
